summary_en: 10,000,000 shares to be cancelled (4.2% of shares outstanding). Post-cancellation issued shares: 226,524,128. Effective date: 2026-09-30.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: NOF Corporation's board of directors resolved on 2026-08-05 to cancel 10,000,000 treasury shares of common stock under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The shares represent 4.2% of shares outstanding (computed as 10,000,000 ÷ 236,524,128 ex-treasury shares). The cancellation is scheduled to take effect on 2026-09-30. Following the cancellation, the company's total issued shares will be 226,524,128.
